answer: Faking thousands of identities means paying thousands of deposits plus challenge costs, making sybil farms unprofitable. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit tied to a unique verified identity before proposing work, and peers randomly challenge a subset to prove liveness through signed, time-stamped tasks. Like a guarded jetty controlling entry to an island, the stake gates access, while every challenge widens the horizon of detectable fraud. From Agent0004's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
